faqPage.title: FAQs
faqPage.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.desc: Find answers to your questions about Buddy Review. Whether you're a brand looking for the right influencer or an influencer looking to monetize, we have the answers you need.
faqPage.contactUsPrompt: If you have more questions, you can

faqsBrand.q: What services does Buddy Review provide?
faqsBrand.a: We provide end-to-end Influencer Marketing services, from strategy planning, selecting the right influencers, coordinating, monitoring work, to measuring campaign success.

faqsBrand.q: How is your service better than doing it ourselves?
faqsBrand.a: Using our service saves you time and eliminates the hassle of finding, selecting, negotiating, and managing numerous influencers. We have precise data tools and a professional team taking care of every step from planning to measuring results, ensuring you get the most suitable influencers and highly effective campaigns.

faqsBrand.q: How do you charge for your services?
faqsBrand.a: Service fees depend on campaign size, the number of influencers, and the services you need. Our minimum campaign budget starts at 100,000 THB per campaign.

faqsBrand.q: What do I need to prepare before starting a campaign?
faqsBrand.a: Just let us know your campaign objectives, budget, target audience, and product/service details. We will take care of the rest.

faqsBrand.q: What do you use to select influencers?
faqsBrand.a: We use a Data-Driven Matching system that analyzes Demographics, Engagement, Unique Follower Overlap, and past campaign performance. This helps us select influencers that align perfectly with your brand's goals and match the influencer's followers.

faqsBrand.q: Can I request a report at the end of the campaign?
faqsBrand.a: You will receive a comprehensive campaign performance report covering Reach, Engagement, ROI, top-performing influencers, and insights to improve your next campaigns.

faqsBrand.q: Can I choose the influencers myself?
faqsBrand.a: If you have specific influencers in mind, we can contact them for you or recommend similar ones. We will handle all communications on your behalf.

faqsBrand.q: Which platforms can campaigns run on?
faqsBrand.a: We support all major platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X (Twitter), and Lemon8. We can recommend the best platforms based on your target audience, content, and campaign objectives.

faqsInfluencer.q: Will I get jobs immediately after signing up?
faqsInfluencer.a: Once registered, our system evaluates incoming campaigns. If there is a campaign that matches your profile, you will receive a notification to join immediately.

faqsInfluencer.q: Why haven't I received any jobs after signing up?
faqsInfluencer.a: Each campaign depends on the brand's target audience. If you haven't received jobs, we recommend updating your profile and linking all your social media channels to increase your chances of being matched.

faqsInfluencer.q: Do I need to link my social media accounts?
faqsInfluencer.a: We recommend linking your social media accounts so the system can pull statistics and automatically match you with suitable campaigns. If you encounter any issues linking your accounts, contact us on LINE @buddysupport.

The system pays in points, where 10 points = 1 THB. Reviewers must initiate a withdrawal and submit required documents. Withdrawals are open at the beginning of the month, and transfers are made between the 15th–20th of the following month (after document verification).

faqsInfluencer.q: Why did I receive a notification but the money hasn't arrived?
faqsInfluencer.a: Before the money is actually transferred to your bank account, you might receive an advance notification from the bank about an incoming transfer. The money will be transferred according to the date and time specified in the bank's message.

faqsInfluencer.q: What documents are required to receive payment?
faqsInfluencer.a: A copy of your ID card, bank account number, and a copy of your bank book are required for withdrawals.

There is an 8 THB transfer fee per transaction, and a minimum withdrawal of 2,000 points (200 THB) is required. Example: If you have 2,500 points (250 THB) and initiate a withdrawal, the system deducts an 8 THB fee, so you will receive 242 THB in your account.

faqsInfluencer.q: What should I do if I forget my email or can't log in?
faqsInfluencer.a: Contact our support team via LINE: @buddysupport and provide your account name so the team can verify and reset your password.

successStories.tagline: From foodies to gamers, Buddy Review made Nissin a hit across all generations.
paras: Nissin launched a fun online campaign featuring influencers with diverse styles, creating mouth-watering content that went viral.

Nissin introduced its new 'Spicy Tom Yum Cheese' flavor, combining the bold taste of Thai Tom Yum with the smooth richness of cheese for a unique and tempting experience. Buddy Review designed and planned a campaign to reach every segment—from movie buffs and gamers to foodies and lifestyle enthusiasts. We engaged influencers ranging from Nano to Mega KOLs in the Foodie, Gamer, and Lifestyle categories, and created snackable content that is easy to watch, quick to enjoy, and visually memorable with melting cheese, blowtorched cheese, and onsen eggs to trigger immediate cravings.

successStories.tagline: Creating 'Shop Watsons under 500' content to spark a value-shopping social trend.
paras: Watsons wanted to reinforce its brand image as the ultimate destination for quality and value products while promoting its House Brand. Buddy Review executed a campaign on TikTok and Lemon8, inviting influencers to create content around the challenge: 'How many Watsons-branded items can you buy with a 500 THB budget?' to create a fun and highly shareable shopping atmosphere.

Buddy Review used a 'friend-recommending-friend' storytelling strategy, having creators showcase real in-store shopping and natural product usage. We leveraged TikTok for vibrant short-form review videos and Lemon8 for aesthetic visuals paired with detailed recommendations.

successStories.tagline: Boosting LDC's clear aligner services with strong buzz and a trip to England giveaway.
paras: LDC Dental, a leading dental clinic in Thailand, partnered with Buddy Review to promote its clear aligner (Invisalign) services and launch a campaign that blended creative marketing with social value through carefully selected influencers.

Buddy Review selected influencers that matched the brand in both the health and family categories to create highly accessible service reviews. We also designed interactive activities offering a chance to win tickets to watch a football match in England, driving massive audience engagement.

successStories.tagline: Combining influencers and local content to elevate Viu in the hearts of the Isan people.
paras: Viu, a leading Asian streaming platform, collaborated with Buddy Review to create the 'Isan Watch Viu' campaign. This initiative brought the classic outdoor cinema experience to the Isan region while introducing popular series dubbed in the local Isan dialect. This approach effectively reached and built strong connections with the local target audience, making the campaign not just entertaining but also a powerful brand communication tool.

Buddy Review focused on utilizing local influencers to establish credibility and convey the event experience through engaging video content. We supported the creation of highly shareable content that perfectly captured the unique style of each influencer.

successStories.tagline: ENO and Guss Damn Good teamed up to create a new ice cream flavor called 'After Meal'.
paras: ENO, everyone's favorite post-meal effervescent powder, stepped beyond its traditional boundaries for a highly refreshing campaign. This time, ENO didn't just come in a sachet—it came with a flavor that told a story and an experience everyone wanted to try and talk about.

This campaign utilized an Influencer Marketing strategy with Buddy Review by selecting foodies, comedians, and creative influencers. This made the content fun, engaging, and told the flavor story in a unique way, generating excellent talkability on social media.

successStories.tagline: Igniting brand buzz with an event inspired by a viral series.
paras: AHC, a Korean skincare brand, hosted a highly creative event, 'AHC Skin Game THE T-SHOT', inspired by the hit Netflix series 'Squid Game'. This innovative brand promotion experience was designed specifically to attract younger audiences and series fans.

Buddy Review planned the strategy by bringing in top-tier influencers, amplifying the impact with PR from leading media outlets, and tailoring the content for each platform. We also monitored results in real time to ensure the campaign's success and viral reach.
